newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian CPI should withstand strong dollar -Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italian CPI should withstand strong dollar -Istat.

text.p: The recent strength of the dollar should not have a major repercussion on Italian inflation, with companies capable of absorbing the currency fluctuations, a senior official at statistics office Istat said.
"From an accounting point of view, (the strong dollar) will not have a huge effect," said Enrico Giovannini, head of Istat's economic department.

"It's clear that costs will go up, but Italian companies have shown they are capable of working over the medium-term and therefore of drawing up price plans, absorbing oscillating costs," he told reporters.
Earlier Istat reported that inflation rose 1.6 percent year-on-year in July against 1.4 percent in June.

The government is concerned that recent strong gains by the dollar, which has hit its highest level against the lira since 1989, will have a negative impact on inflation. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
